:::{#thm-wcgs-intercept}

#### Interpretation of the intercept in the WCGS interaction model

In the model of @eq-wcgs-model-1,
write $\odds(p, a) \eqdef \oddst(Y=1|P=p, A=a)$
for the odds of CHD at covariate values $(p, a)$.
Then the intercept $\beta_0$ is the log-odds of CHD for a person with type B personality ($P = 0$) and age $0$:

$$\beta_{0} = \eta(P=0,A=0)$$

and $\expf{\beta_0}$ is the corresponding odds:

$$\expf{\beta_{0}} = \odds(P=0,A=0)$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-logistic-coef-interp.

:::
